component.name: omux
component.summary: Run many Claude Code and Codex sessions side by side

description.p: omux groups agent sessions into projects in a sidebar. Each session keeps its conversation across relaunches and shows whether its agent is working, needs you or is done.
This is the Linux version of omux for macOS by Onur Özcan (https://github.com/onurozcan/omux).

ul.li: Allow or deny tool permissions from the sidebar
Worktree sessions with pull request status
Files, Changes and Browser panels per session
